data.name: Afeefa
data.gender_notes: Afeefa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afeefa is an Arabic name that signifies purity and chastity. It is a virtuous name that reflects the Islamic values of modesty and morality. The name Afeefa carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afeefa usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Afeefa is associated with the concept of taharah (purity) and is considered a blessed name for girls.
data.etymology: Afeefa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afeefa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عفيفة
in_arabic.meaning: عفيفة تعني النقية من الشوب والعيب والسوء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عفيفة مشتق من الفعل عَفِفَ، ويعني النقي من الشوب والعيب والسوء. في اللغة العربية، العفيفة هي المرأة التي تتصف بالعفاف والطهارة، وتعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وصفات حميدة. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مواضع تتعلق بالعفة والطهارة، مما يعزز الأهمية الروحية والاجتماعية لهذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: عفیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: عفیفہ یعنی خالص، پاکیزہ، اور بے داغ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام عفیفہ عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'عَفِفَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خالص، پاکیزہ، اور بے داغ۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، عفیفہ کا نام روحانی صفائی اور شائستگی کی علامت ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، یہ نام پاکستانی اور ہندوستانی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے، جو عفت اور تقویٰ کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अफीफा
in_hindi.meaning: अफीफा अर्थात शुद्ध, पवित्र और बेदाग
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अफीफा अरबी शब्द 'عَفِفَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शुद्ध, पवित्र और बेदाग। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अफीफा नाम आध्यात्मिक पवित्रता और सादगी का प्रतीक है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह नाम भारतीय और पाकिस्तानी मुसलमानों द्वारा व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में शुद्धता और सच्चाई के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عفيفه
in_pashto.meaning: عفيفه د پاکۍ او بې ګناهۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عفيفه نوم د عربي کلمې 'عَفِفَ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د پاکۍ او بې ګناهۍ معنی لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، عفيفه د پاک زړه او روحاني صفاء نښه ده. دا نوم د پښتو ژبې د عربي ریشه لرونکي الفاظو برخه ده، او د افغانستان او پاکستان د مسلمانانو تر منځ مشهور دی، چې د عفت او تقویٰ ارزښتونه منعکس کوي.

in_english.name: Afeefa
in_english.meaning: Pure, chaste, and free from impurities or defects
in_english.long_meaning: The name Afeefa originates from the Arabic root 'عَفِفَ', meaning pure, chaste, and free from impurities or defects. In Islamic tradition, Afeefa signifies spiritual cleanliness and integrity. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing modesty and piety. The Quranic emphasis on purity and righteousness further underscores the significance of this name, which is popular among Muslims worldwide for its positive connotations and aspirational qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Afeefa can be seen as having a widespread cultural impact as it is highly valued and revered in the Islamic world and beyond. It is often given to girls as a symbol of their parents' hope for their purity, innocence, and moral development. Moreover, the name Afeefa is associated with the pre-Islamic Arab civilization where the term 'aafaa' was used to describe a type of white, pure hue. This connection to the past adds a rich cultural significance to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Afeefa holds a deep spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. In the spirit of striving for moral purity, it is a reminder to live in the light of Allah's guidance and to uphold the highest moral standards of kindness, generosity, and truthfulness. It is a name that inspires reverence, attracts blessings, and encourages the bearer to maintain a strong connection with Allah. Ultimately, Afeefa is a testament to an Islamic worldview that strives towards inner spiritual transformation through moral integrity.
